# Version endpoint

`GET /api/v1/version` returns the version of the running service.

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/version
# {"version": "1.0.0"}
```

## Decision (ADR-001)

The version is read from the FastAPI application object, so a release only bumps it in one place.
No authentication is required: the version is not sensitive.

decisions.rationale: One file per change keeps history readable
